changelog:
- Initial release of savemaintenance skill.
- Provides a one-shot tool to reconcile conversation logs, memory index, and saved conversation files.
- Includes backup, reconcile, rebuild, and audit steps to ensure memory system coherence.
- Offers manual and automated snapshot/restore tools.
- Requires Python 3 and the save skill; no external dependencies needed.
summary:
Deterministic reconciliation of conversation-log.md, FTS5 index, and saved conversations — one-shot fix or maintenance run
Sister skill to the save skill, only get this if you are planning on getting and using the save skill by the same author
